description: This is a test source file using pytest that verifies the behavior of the 'add_deployment' method in the litellm proxy server when certain encryption keys or master keys are absent. It contains async test functions that mock dependencies and test different scenarios to ensure robustness without raising exceptions.

methods.name: test_add_deployment_without_master_key()
methods.description: Tests that the add_deployment method works correctly when the master_key is set to None, ensuring no exceptions are raised during its execution.

methods.name: test_add_deployment_without_salt_key_or_master_key()
methods.description: Verifies that add_deployment works properly when both the salt key environment variable and the master_key are unset, simulating a local development environment.

methods.name: test_add_deployment_sync_without_master_key()
methods.description: Tests the internal synchronous method _add_deployment to confirm it executes without error when the master_key is None.
